test.result: 3 passed; Ruff and mypy passed for matched_performance.py.

implemented: Daily net returns are computed from NAV and interval cash flows, retaining zero-return cash sessions.
Strategy and benchmark return streams must have the exact same dates; missing or duplicate dates fail closed.
The matcher requires the same positive declared INR risk budget for every paired session and emits per-session net alpha.
Sample count and paired return values are returned without comparing unmatched rupee P&L.
limitations: NAV inputs must already include actual marks, fees, charges, financing and other account effects; the helper does not invent these inputs.
No real forward strategy/benchmark session was available in this test; this is software acceptance evidence only.
